issues.problem: Even with the completion tier, the default-branch check compares only literal destination names. 'git push origin HEAD' and 'git push origin @' made on main push main, and 'git push origin v1.0.0' pushes a release tag, yet all three stay intermediate.
issues.evidence: p22.sh with push_to_default_branch_tier=completion, on main: 'git push origin HEAD' -> 'Intermediate commit allowed'; 'git push origin @' -> same; 'git push origin v1.0.0' -> same. SB_SA_JSON push = {refspecs:['HEAD'], dsts:['HEAD'], default:false}.
issues.suggested_fix: Resolve each destination before matching: HEAD and @ (and a source without ':') map to the current branch (git symbolic-ref --short HEAD); a short name that resolves with git rev-parse --verify refs/tags/<name> counts as a tag push. Add test rows for each form.

issues.location: hooks/lib/cert-bypass.sh:12-28 (sb_runtime_in_test_sandbox); used by sb_cert_run_bypass_active, sb_github_overrides_allowed, capability-tier.sh
issues.problem: The sandbox test trusts $TMPDIR, which the agent controls when it starts a nested host CLI (the R4-01 scenario). TMPDIR=/ becomes an empty root, so every absolute path counts as a sandbox. TMPDIR=$HOME covers the real state dir. Either one restores SB_AGENT_CERT_RUN, GH_RUN_LIST_OVERRIDE_CMD (run by the hook through bash -lc, which also fakes green CI), GH_STATUS_OVERRIDE, SILVER_BULLET_SKIP_ENFORCEMENT_TIER_GATE and SILVER_BULLET_TEST_HOOK_ENFORCED against the real home.
issues.evidence: SB_RUNTIME_STATE_DIR=/home/fake/.claude/.silver-bullet SB_AGENT_CERT_RUN=1 TMPDIR=<x> bash -c 'source hooks/lib/cert-bypass.sh; sb_cert_run_bypass_active' -> x='' gates on; x='/' BYPASS ACTIVE; x='/home/fake' BYPASS ACTIVE; x='/home' BYPASS ACTIVE.
issues.suggested_fix: Drop TMPDIR from the roots and use fixed system roots only (/tmp, /var/tmp, /private/tmp, /var/folders, /private/var/folders). Reject an empty or '/' root. Also refuse when the state dir is under the passwd home of the current user (python3 -c 'import pwd,os;print(pwd.getpwuid(os.getuid()).pw_dir)' or ~$(id -un)). Add tests for TMPDIR=/ and TMPDIR=$HOME.

issues.problem: The CI-red gate still decides with a raw regex over the command text, not the F2 classifier the package must use. Common spellings, and MCP, skip the CI-red block.
issues.evidence: pci.sh, fake gh reporting conclusion=failure, PreToolUse: 'git push origin feature/x' -> DENY; 'git -C . push origin feature/x' -> SILENT; 'git -c x.y=1 push' -> SILENT; 'gh pr new --fill' -> SILENT; 'gh -R o/r pr create --fill' -> SILENT; mcp__github__create_pull_request -> SILENT (ci-status-check is not on the mcp matcher).
issues.suggested_fix: Classify with sb_shell_analysis_load / sb_shell_analysis_has_action (push, pr_create, pr_merge, release_create, possible actions) as completion-audit does, and treat helper_unavailable as gated. Optionally add the mcp__.* matcher. Use the analysed push (not a 'git push' grep) for the CI-fix exemption.

issues.problem: The release commit is parsed only from a 'gh release create' argv. The 'gh api .../releases -f target_commitish=<sha>' spelling, which the classifier already rates as release, and MCP create_release fall back to origin/HEAD. So CI is checked for the wrong commit: the R1-19/R13-08 bypass in a different spelling.
issues.evidence: proj22: main=03c9517 (local), origin/main=d6f3ae9, red=572797f. ca_release_commit_sha after sb_shell_analysis_load: 'gh release create v9 --target 572797f…' -> 572797f; 'gh api repos/o/r/releases -f tag_name=v9 -f target_commitish=572797f…' -> d6f3ae9; '--raw-field target_commitish=…' -> d6f3ae9.
issues.suggested_fix: Also read tag_name / target_commitish from gh api -f/-F/--raw-field/--field and from the MCP payload (tool_input.target_commitish / tag_name). If a release target is present but cannot be resolved, deny.

issues.problem: Regression: the snippet's documented use is to be copied into a deploy or CI script. A copy without hooks/lib now calls the undefined sb_expand_state_config_path; the ERR trap exits 0, so the deploy gate passes. Before this change the same copy blocked (rc 1).
issues.evidence: Copied snippet to snip/scripts/, template project, empty state: new copy 'bash deploy-gate-snippet.sh' -> 'line 80: sb_expand_state_config_path: command not found', rc=0. Old copy (94800f8) -> rc=1. In-plugin -> rc=1.
issues.suggested_fix: Define fallbacks inline when the library is missing (expand ~ and ${SB_RUNTIME_HOME_ROOT}; with no validator, ignore the config paths and keep the defaults), or fail closed (return 1 with a message) when the helpers are absent. Add a test that runs a copied snippet.

issues.problem: Semantic merge hazard. G1 moves completion-audit into a new 'Bash|exec_command|mcp__.*' group, and G2 appends spec-floor-check, forbidden-skill-check and uat-gate after completion-audit in the 'Bash|Skill|exec_command' group. git merge-tree resolves this cleanly but puts those three hooks into G1's group, so they lose the Skill matcher (forbidden-skill-check stops blocking forbidden Skill calls) and gain mcp__.*. docs/HOOKS.md conflicts outright.
issues.evidence: git merge-tree --write-tree HEAD eb32cff -> CONFLICT docs/HOOKS.md; merged hooks.json PreToolUse: {m:'Bash|Skill|exec_command',h:[phase-archive]}, {m:'Bash|exec_command|mcp__.*',h:[completion-audit,spec-floor-check,forbidden-skill-check,uat-gate]}. Merge with c591ebb: clean.
issues.suggested_fix: When merging G1 and G2, put spec-floor-check, forbidden-skill-check and uat-gate back under 'Bash|Skill|exec_command' by hand, regenerate docs/HOOKS.md and the cursor hooks, and add an invariant or test asserting forbidden-skill-check's matcher includes Skill.

issues.problem: R3-02 (critical) is reported as fixed, but stop-check still honours any state.trivial_file, and the hand-off has no owner: G1 names G2/G4, and G2 names G1/G3.
issues.evidence: fix-G1 R3-02 notes: 'stop-check.sh:103-129 still reads state.trivial_file unvalidated'. fix-G2 R1-07: 'completion-audit/ci-status-check/stop-check/deploy-gate-snippet ... validate state.trivial_file (G1/G3)'.
issues.suggested_fix: Mark R3-02 partial and assign stop-check's sb_trivial_path_trusted call to one package (it is a two-line change; G1 can make it, since the helper is G1's).

issues.problem: Messages for code that cannot be inspected. When the enterprise gate does not fire (approved, or another profile), the deploy tier tells the agent 'You are attempting to create a PR/deploy' for 'npm test' (helper failed) or 'eval "$X"'. For a failed helper, the enterprise message cuts the reason mid-path at 80 characters and advises 'rewrite the command as plain, separate commands', which is wrong for an already-plain command.
issues.evidence: phelp.sh (python3 stubbed to fail): 'npm test' + approval -> 'COMPLETION BLOCKED ... You are attempting to create a PR/deploy'; without approval -> 'cannot inspect: the shell analysis helper failed (the python3 helper failed: /home/user/silver-b' + 'rewrite the command as plain...'. git status / git log stay silent (good).
issues.suggested_fix: In the deploy tier, when ca_unseen_reasons is set, say 'cannot inspect: <reason>'. For helper_unavailable, say that Silver Bullet's analysis helper failed and how to fix it (check python3, reinstall), and do not suggest rewriting the command.

issues.problem: The read-only fallback rejects '~' and '^', so under a helper failure 'git diff HEAD~1' and 'git show HEAD^' are held as deliveries.
issues.evidence: phelp.sh: 'git diff HEAD~1' -> ENTERPRISE POLICY BLOCK cannot inspect.
issues.suggested_fix: Allow ~ and ^ in the character class; neither is a shell metacharacter when it is not at the start of a word.

issues.problem: A verify-tests marker with no repo_root line is accepted, although the comment says such a marker does not vouch for the project (the tests write such markers).
issues.suggested_fix: Require repo_root (verify-tests.sh writes it), or correct the comment.

issues.problem: The fail-closed ERR trap is not inherited into the functions (no set -E). A failure inside ca_run_deploy_tier_gate or the planning tier exits 1, which is non-blocking, instead of a deny. The error text always blames the state directory, even for a malformed config.
issues.evidence: bash -c 'set -euo pipefail; trap "echo TRAP; exit 0" ERR; f(){ false; }; f' -> rc=1, no TRAP. p09.sh: malformed .silver-bullet.json -> '...Check that <state dir> is a real directory'.
issues.suggested_fix: set -E after classification, plus a generic message that names the line and the config/state checks. No agent-reachable trigger was found inside the tiers.

issues.problem: MCP coverage and cost: create_pull_request_with_copilot is not gated; actions_run_trigger counts as a deploy even for cancel_workflow_run (a false positive); and every MCP call (Gmail, Context7...) now runs the full analysis.
issues.evidence: pmcp.sh: create_pull_request_with_copilot -> SILENT. Timing: mcp__context7__query-docs completion-audit 343 ms (base) -> 636 ms (head), 5-run average under load.
issues.suggested_fix: Add the copilot PR tool; classify actions_run_trigger by method; pre-filter MCP tool names against the _MCP_ACTIONS suffixes before sourcing the libraries.

issues.problem: Replacing SPEC.md with the mktemp file leaves it mode 0600.
issues.evidence: mktemp creates 0600, then mv -f over SPEC.md.
issues.suggested_fix: chmod --reference is not portable; copy the mode with stat -f/-c, or write with cat > over a validated regular file.

issues.problem: R1-13 residual: under internal_dogfood, a non-production keyword in any deploy argument exempts a production deploy.
issues.evidence: pent.sh: 'vercel deploy --prod --token internal' and 'fly deploy -a prod-app --strategy=preview' -> no ENTERPRISE block.
issues.suggested_fix: Match the keyword only in the target-naming arguments (an environment flag, a target name), or document the residual.

issues.problem: Both still describe the completion audit as '(Pre+PostToolUse/Bash)'; it now also gates mcp__* tools. Update both copies in parity, together with the R1-22 wording.
